_comment: Shared category taxonomy. Consumed by the PWA at runtime and (later) by the
desktop GeoJSON editor. Edit this file to retune bucketing without touching code.
Resolution order for any place (1-2 categories, capped - the split-colour
pin only reads cleanly as two halves):
1. properties.user.buckets  - explicit override array, wins over everything (editor writes this)
2. properties.user.bucket   - legacy singular field, still honoured unmigrated
3. rules below vs. properties.category, first token first, weak tokens last
4. 'other'
'research-needed' is a hard-coded category, always available, NOT part of
this file - it exists in code (js/categories.js, editor.html) so it can never
be renamed/deleted out from under a place that's flagged unvetted.
properties.user is the user-authored namespace: { buckets, note, tags, status,
rating, hidden }. A re-import from exportmymap only ever appends new places -
existing properties.user is never touched.
properties.category is an ARRAY of category strings from exportmymap, primary
category first. A comma-joined string is also accepted for hand-edited files.
'match' entries are lowercase substrings tested against each category token.
Order within a bucket does not matter;
order of the buckets array DOES - earlier buckets win ties.
Prefix an entry with '=' to require an EXACT token match instead of a substring.
Needed where a short word hides inside unrelated ones: '=inn' so it does not
catch 'dinner', '=park' so it does not catch 'parking lot', '=bar' so it does
not catch 'barber shop'.
